text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! A church, it's a church~!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Evacuation to the safe zone is complete. 
We can safely say the threats we faced— 
the thunderstorm and mudslides—have 
passed.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm so sorry, both of you...! 
It's all Rice's fault that—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
All personnel: zero hull damage. Lodging 
has also been successfully secured. Is 
there a problem?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
“Still, you almost got hurt... and it was 
Rice who asked to go on a picnic in the 
first place.”

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! In this bento, we're standing on 
an open field!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...I made this wondering if we could 
become like that too... but—"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You're right, all smiles! Just like us!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-It's not the same... Because this isn't 
an open field... This isn't a picnic...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm having so much fun! It's my very first 
time having a sleepover at a church!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This matter has also been quite a 
fascinating experience.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Still...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Well, if today doesn't work out, we can 
always just try again another time, right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I want to play with Rice-chan way, way 
more!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Spring means cherry blossom viewing and 
feeling Urara-cheerful!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Summer means swimming in the sea with 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Then, autumn means autumn leaf viewing, 
doesn't it? Operation 'Roasted Sweet 
Potato' sounds quite intriguing as well.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...If you fail, all you must do is try 
again. If you are feeling anxious, let us 
swear upon the Three Goddesses."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I will accompany you as many times as it 
takes. Because I am Rice-san's friend, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Me too! We'll play together forever and 
ever, and be friends forever and ever!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan... Bourbon-san...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
…………In the winter, will you build a 
snowman with Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even with Rice being like this... will you 
still stay with me...?

text_block_list.name: Urara & Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you... ...Rice makes that vow 
too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: All along—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Friends...
